report.explanation: All current evidence is healthy: gateway checkout span OK at 72ms, p95 73ms, error_rate 0.0012, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, and INFO 200 logs from gateway and order. This contradicts the degraded-checkout alert and supports no bounded root cause. Handing off for evidence of the actual degradation.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows errors, latency, or saturation consistent with the degraded checkout alert; need evidence of the actual degradation.
No db pool, redis, or dependency timeout metrics beyond gateway aggregate; need per-dependency timeout/waiter data.
No memory-retention time series to assess a leak; need chronological per-service retention facts.
No deployment records or config-change facts to assess bad-configuration or deployment-caused latency.
